newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African producer price inflation at 21-mth high.
newsitem.headline: S.African producer price inflation at 21-mth high.

text.p: South Africa's annual producer price inflation in March was at the highest level in 21 months, the nation's Central Statistical Service (CSS) announced on Thursday.

The CSS March production price index for all commodities consumed in South Africa rose 0.1 percent from February giving a year on year increase of 9.6 percent at March compared with 9.3 percent in February.
The result was broadly in line with economists expectations of a 0.1 percent rise to an annual price inflation rate of 9.7 percent.

The CSS data showed the biggest contibutors to the March monthly rise were fishing products, which were up 4.6 percent, followed by other agricultural products (4.0 percent), leather and leather products (2.1 percent) and wearing apparel (2.0 percent).
The largest detractor from producer price inflation growth in March was a 3.6 percent fall in petroleum and coal product prices.
Immediate market reaction to the data was muted.
